companyFieldUpdates.name: Cambrian Innovation
companyFieldUpdates.description: Cambrian Innovation, Inc. develops, owns and operates distributed industrial wastewater treatment, water-reuse and energy-recovery infrastructure through service-based Water-Energy Purchase Agreement structures. Pennybacker-affiliated funds acquired Cambrian on November 16, 2023 and committed up to US$200 million of growth equity; current company materials continue to identify Pennybacker as the corporate owner. Generate Capital's earlier participation concerned project-level WEPA financing and jointly owned project vehicles beginning in 2015, not current corporate ownership, and its exact project-SPV stake and exit date were not publicly disclosed. Cambrian announced a US$150 million ING credit facility in June 2025 to expand its active infrastructure portfolio; that facility is debt. No later corporate sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 29, 2026.
